text.description_html:
Deltana KP634U19, Matte Black 6" Wide and 34" Long Stainless Steel Kick Plate

Common size door kick plates primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel for longevity. The Kick Plate is 6" wide and 34" long. It is made out of stainless steel with a mattel black finish. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: 8" x 34" Matte Black Kick Plate and 10" x 34" Matte Black Kick Plate

Specifications of the 6 x 34 Matte Black Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Plate Height: 6"
  • Plate Width: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with stainless mounting screws.
  • Deltana KP634U19 Dimensions (PDF)

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36 inches wide you would install a 34 inch wide kick plate. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.
